lines.text: Equipment Type | Example Make/Model | Quantity | Additional Notes

Rack | 19-inch equipment rack 24U wall-mount | 1 | Rack to store/mount MX devices, switch, UPS, related components.

Related Components | Vertical/Horizontal Cable Management | 50000 | Whatever is needed for the rack.
